sftp_listen_port.description: Port on which the SSH/SFTP server listens for incoming connections.

sftp_bind_address.description: IP address to bind to (e.g., '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces or a specific IP). Leave empty to use default.

password_auth_enabled.description: Allow password-based authentication. Set to 'false' for key-only access (recommended).

sftp_chroot_dir.description: Root directory for SFTP chroot jail. Must be owned by root and not writable by the user.

items.description: Username to restrict to SFTP-only (no shell access). Users must exist on the system.

sftp_only_users.description: List of users to apply SFTP-only restrictions (chroot, internal-sftp, no forwarding).

sftp_client_alive_interval.description: Seconds between client alive messages (to detect dead connections). Set to 0 to disable.

sftp_client_alive_count_max.description: Number of client alive messages without response before disconnecting the client.

sftp_log_level.description: Verbosity of logging (e.g., QUIET, FATAL, ERROR, INFO, VERBOSE, DEBUG).

sftp_max_sessions.description: Maximum number of sessions per network connection (limits concurrent SFTP uploads/downloads).

sftp_login_grace_time.description: Seconds the server waits for successful authentication before disconnecting.

items.description: SSH group name allowed to log in (users must be members of the group).

ssh_allow_groups.description: List of Unix groups whose members are permitted to connect via SSH/SFTP. Leave empty to allow all users.
